svg.aria-label: Per-tactic detection analytic density across the ATT&CK v19 Enterprise matrix
svg.text: Analytic Density Per Tactic, ATT&CK v19 Enterprise
Rows in kill chain order. Cell shade scales with the column maximum. Counts include sub-techniques.
The two tactics from the split article are outlined. Defense Impairment carries the thinnest source variety of any post-access tactic.

g.text: Shade = value as fraction of column max:

svg.text: Density measures how much analytic text MITRE wrote, not how detectable the tactic is in a live environment.
